drum_performances.name: Benny Benjamin
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Credited to him: the snare on every beat from start to fade, eighths on the hat, the kick on the 'and's under Jamerson's bass. Reconstructed from the record; no human drum transcription.

drums.description: The snare on every beat with Jack Ashford's tambourine, eighths on the hat, the kick on the 'and's of 2, 3 and 4 under Jamerson's bass.

evidence.note: From the record folded onto a sixteenth grid (straight, no shuffle) and a machine tab's snare; the kick needs a human transcription.
